correctness.rationale: Independent 33-perfect-matching enumerations and complete 11,068-matching extendibility check certify the entire 6,051-face complex. The 3,014-pair matching is acyclic on all 27,192 Hasse covers; its critical-cell vector is (one 0-cell, nine 2-cells, thirteen 3-cells). Signed gradient-path elimination yields a 9x13 integral degree matrix of rank five containing a determinant-minus-one 5x5 minor. This forces all five nonzero Smith factors to be one, and Hurewicz on the 2-skeleton gives the mixed-dimensional wedge of four 2-spheres and eight 3-spheres. Raw mod-two boundary ranks separately give Betti 4 and 8.

value.rationale: A canonical 16-vertex symmetric cubic incidence graph, for which ordinary matching topology is already known, has a naturally defined but topologically unclassified perfect-extendibility subcomplex. The exact integral homotopy splitting is mixed-dimensional and differs markedly from the ordinary complex, without following from its facet count. This is a natural complete finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine substitution.
